notes.title: New Legendary Girl: URIEL
notes.content:
🌟 URIEL Has Arrived in Eros Fantasy! 🌟

Meet Uriel, the newest Celestial hero, bringing powerful healing and support to your team!

[list]
[*] Basic Ability: Every 5 seconds, heals the weakest ally and adds a barrier if she's Celestial. Casts two extra times with a short delay.
[*] Special Ability: Heals all allies, removes negative effects, and clears Dark Marks for Celestial teams.
[*] Passive Skills: Uriel starts combat with Immortality if there's another Celestial ally and becomes Untargettable when hit with lethal damage. She also boosts Tenacity for allied Celestials and clears debuffs when their health is low.
[/list]

✨ LEGENDARY EVENT ✨
Uriel’s event launched 14 hours ago! To unlock her, gather 5 Celestial heroes with 5 stars.

Are you ready to add this divine healer to your team?

[*]Alexandra, Ivy, Audrey, Lisa, Shannon, Chelsea, Roselyn, Isabella, Lixue-Lang, Ivonne, Gabriela, Daphne, Rebecca, and Valeria.

[i](More characters and dates coming soon!)[/i]

notes.title: 81n4's Legendary Event!
notes.content:
🚨 [b]New Legendary Character Release: 81n4![/b] 🚨

The time has come, adventurers! The Raiders team is finally complete with the release of its 6th and final member—the beautiful and powerful [b]81n4 (Bina)[/b], the Legendary character you've all been waiting for!

🛡️ [b]Meet 81n4:[/b]

Known for her unmatched tactical brilliance and awesome skills, 81n4 stands at the pinnacle of the Raiders. Her presence on the battlefield will turn the tide of any battle.

⚔️ [b]How to Unlock 81n4:[/b]
As in any other Legendary event, to fully unlock 81n4 you'll need to:
[list]
[*]Fight in the 81n4 Legendary Event.
[*]Recruit all 5 previous Raiders team members and rank them up to Rank 5 (5 stars) to be able to complete Event level 5, getting enough shards to recruit 81n4.
[/list]

🎉 [b]Don't Miss Out:[/b]

This is your chance to complete the Raiders team and add this Legendary warrior to your roster. Join the battle now, and make 81n4 the ultimate weapon in your fight!
